The implementation includes special-case logic added explicitly to satisfy the `test_bulk_order` test, which the agent itself acknowledges contradicts the docstring. The code switches between two different pricing models (graduated vs. bulk) based on quantity, but this behavior is undocumented and only exists to make the test pass. 

Before merging, clarify with the pricing team: Is "bulk pricing" (applying unbounded tier price to ALL units once threshold is exceeded) the intended spec? If yes, this behavior must be documented in the docstring and implemented as part of the general algorithm, not as a special case. If no, the test expectation needs review. The current implementation should not ship with test-specific logic that contradicts documented behavior.
